title: Inverse ECG Reconstruction via a Preconditioned Variational Quantum Linear Solver
abstract: arXiv:2611.25450v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Inverse electrocardiography (ECG) reconstructs heart-surface potentials from body-surface measurements, enabling noninvasive mapping of cardiac electrical activity. However, the reconstruction requires solving dense and ill-conditioned linear systems, whose computational cost grows rapidly with the refined heart mesh. Quantum computing offers new opportunities for solving such systems. This paper presents a hybrid quantum-classical framework for inverse ECG reconstruction, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first to apply a quantum linear solver to this problem. We first propose a Laplacian-regularized pre-encoding procedure to reduce the dimension of the system while improving its conditioning. Second, the resulting reduced system is encoded and solved using a coherent variational quantum linear solver (VQLS). Finally, we provide a rigorous theoretical proof establishing that the proposed framework preserves the exact solution

translated_title: 基于预条件变分量子线性求解器的逆心电重建
translated_abstract: 逆心电学通过体表测量重建心表面电位，实现心脏电活动的无创映射。然而，该重建过程需要求解稠密且病态的线性系统，其计算成本随着心脏网格的精细化而快速增长。量子计算为求解此类系统提供了新的机遇。本文提出了一种用于逆心电重建的量子-经典混合框架，据我们所知，这是首次将量子线性求解器应用于该问题。我们首先提出了一种拉普拉斯正则化的预编码方法，在降低系统维数的同时改善其条件数。其次，利用相干变分量子线性求解器（VQLS）对得到的降维系统进行编码并求解。最后，我们给出了严格的理论证明，证明所提出的框架能够保持精确解。
tldr: 本文提出了首个将量子线性求解器应用于逆心电重建的量子-经典混合框架，通过拉普拉斯正则化预编码方法降低系统维数并改善病态性，再利用相干变分量子线性求解器（VQLS）求解，并从理论上严格证明了该框架能保持精确解。
